thread:
Elaine: Uploading the security evidence bundle for ACME — pen test report + vuln scans. Redacted for customer PII. Link: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/acme/1781234567_acme_security_bundle.zip (password via LastPass). Please review for vendor risk team and confirm any gaps.
Matt (secops): Got it, downloading now. Do we have the raw Burp/Nessus exports or just the PDF summary?
Elaine: Both. Bundle contains: penetration_test_report.pdf, burp_raw.zip, nessus_scan.xml, remediation_mapping.csv, sanitized_app_logs/, screenshots/. I also added a short README in the root.
vuln-bot: automated-scan complete — discovered 12 findings, 2 critical, 4 high, 6 medium. Full list in nessus_scan.xml.
Matt (secops): Quick skim — I see two critical: SQLi (CVE-2024-8888) and auth bypass on internal admin. Are those reproducible steps in the report?
Raj (backend): I can confirm the auth bypass repro steps, assigning myself for the auth fix. I need the exact request/response logs; are those in sanitized_app_logs/?
Elaine: Yes, sanitized logs include request/response pairs with IPs redacted. The Burp request snapshots are in burp_raw.zip.
Kendra (legal): Heads-up: External share to ACME's vendor team can't include customer PII or internal account IDs. Elaine — please ensure the copy we share replaces IDs with placeholders and include a redaction report.
Elaine: Will do. I'll produce a "for-vendor" bundle with redaction_report.txt and a second zip: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/acme/for-vendor/1781234567_vendor_bundle.zip
Matt (secops): Proposed remediation owners and ETA (short bullet list):
- CVE-2024-8888 (SQLi) — owner: Raj — mitigation: parameterized queries + input validation — target patch: 2025-04-11
- Auth bypass (internal admin) — owner: Raj — mitigation: fixes to auth middleware + additional checks — target patch: 2025-04-09
- Outdated library (high) — owner: @infra-team — mitigation: upgrade lib-crypto -> 2.3.1 — target patch: 2025-04-15
- XSS (medium) — owner: frontend — target patch: 2025-04-18
Raj (backend): Confirming I own the first two. I'll push fixes to the feature/security branch and request a PR review by EOD 2025-04-03.
Sophie (acme_sec): Thanks. ACME vendor team asked for a remediation timeline and retest ETA. They also want evidence that fixes were applied (diffs or PR links are fine). Can you include PR links in the retest bundle?
Elaine: Yes — we'll include PR links and a short QA checklist for retest.
Matt (secops): Retest scheduling — we can do a targeted retest once fixes are merged and a deploy is available. Proposed slot: week of 2025-04-21. Need confirmation from ACME.
Sophie (acme_sec): Week of 4/21 works for us. Please provide at least 48h notice before retest window.
Kendra (legal): Also add a statement of shared responsibility and a redaction attest in the vendor bundle. I can draft language for that.
Elaine: Drafted remediation_mapping.csv includes columns: finding_id, severity, owner, target_patch_date, status, evidence_link. Example row: FIND-001,Critical,Raj,2025-04-11,In Progress,https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987
Matt (secops): Minor asks for the vendor packet before we send externally: remove internal hostnames, sanitize user identifiers, and squash any attached screenshots that contain emails.
Elaine: Noted. I'll produce both: internal bundle (full artifacts + raw logs) and vendor bundle (sanitized + redaction report + remediation tracker).
Raj (backend): I'll drop PR links here once open. Also scheduling a quick internal test: `curl -X POST https://staging.internal/api/login -d "user=redacted&pass=redacted"` — will validate auth fix.
vuln-bot: scheduled re-scan will run 72h after deploy if requested.
Elaine: Action items recap: (1) Elaine — create vendor bundle + redaction report (by 2025-04-04), (2) Raj — PRs for fixes (by 2025-04-03), (3) Infra — upgrade library (by 2025-04-15), (4) Matt — run retest & provide retest report (retest week of 2025-04-21). I'll post the vendor bundle link here when ready.
Sophie (acme_sec): Appreciated. Can you also attach the SOC2/SIG baseline summary? ACME risk team likes to cross-check controls.
Elaine: Adding SIG/SOC2 summary to the vendor bundle (short doc).
Elaine: Final note — flagging one enterprise blocker: ACME's legal wants the pen test author signature on the report. Our 3rd-party tester can provide a signed cover page — I'll coord with them and update the package when we have it.
Kendra (legal): Thanks — once we have the signed page and the sanitized bundle, I approve external share.
Matt (secops): I'll start the internal verification. Ping me when the fixes are in staging. :thumbsup:
Elaine: Thanks everyone — uploading vendor bundle now and will post the link shortly.
